claim.text: At 6.8301 s the struck vehicle became a hazard by closing in the ego lane, with a time-to-collision of 1.9217 s at onset.
Perception took 1.0573 s from hazard onset to first detection, exceeding the 0.3 s threshold.
Command took 0.0516 s from first detection to brake request, within the 0.1 s threshold.
Brake actuation took 0.34 s from CAN brake request to pressure reached, within the 0.45 s threshold.
Impact occurred at 8.0 s, 1.1699 s after hazard onset.
With nominal perception 0.2 s, nominal command 0.05 s, and nominal brake tau 0.35 s, the counterfactual avoided contact with a minimum gap of 0.7748 m.
The brake log was complete, so the timing record is not inconclusive.
The witness reported a dry road surface, corroborated on independent recheck.
